variants.label: Barcode Scanner Input
variants.tooltip: Enables users to scan a barcode directly from a device's built-in camera.

prefix.description: String that marks the start of barcode scan capture.

suffix.description: String that marks the end of barcode scan capture.

regex.description: Regex describing format of scans. The first capture will be used as barcode.

window.description: Length of buffer to monitor for regex match.

captureMode.description: Key capture mode used for specifying key event to listen for.

events.name: onActionPerformed
events.description: This event is fired when the 'action' of the component occurs.
